name: Choksi Laboratories Limited
about: Choksi Laboratories Limited provides contract testing and analytical services in India. The company offers construction material analysis; environmental management analysis, such as ambient and indoor air quality monitoring, fugitive emissions, stack emission monitoring, soil testing, waste water testing, sound level monitoring, and illumination survey; calibration services comprising electro technical, thermal, dimension, pressure, mass and volume, torque and force, medical devices, and flow meters; and autoclave validation and HVAC system, laminar air flow, equipment qualification, and warehousing mapping for temperature and humidity. It also provides food and beverage, pharmaceutical, and water analysis, as well as inspection services. In addition, the company offers research and quality control services for various spectrum of products and material, including pharmaceutical raw materials and formulations, agro products and derivatives, disinfectants / sanitizers, fertilizers, pesticides and agrochemicals, edible and industrial oils, chemicals, paints and dyes, toys, construction materials, etc.; and ISO 900x, ISO 14000, ISO/IEC 17025, GxP, HACCP, etc. Choksi Laboratories Limited was founded in 1982 and is based in Indore, India.
